Company Description: 1Q Health Fast Track to Quality From a product idea to the shelf - We bring your pharmaceutical product or food supplement to life with our full-service contract manufacturing solutions. We work closely with our customers to develop high-quality, innovative products for both human and veterinary use and launch them quickly onto the market. Several individual companies are united under the umbrella of the 1Q Health Group. These include the contract manufacturing companies ABJ alive GmbH, DRONANIA pharmaceuticals GmbH, HKS health solutions GmbH Austria, the medicinal mushroom raw materials offering Mycotrition GmbH and the contract-based research organization (CRO) VivaCell Biotechnlogogy GmbH. The combination of these unique competencies allows us to offer a wide range of services from product development to production and market launch. Our products and services What sets us apart is the full-service model we offer our customers. Alongside comprehensive production and logistics services, we also support clients with studies for testing and developing the right formulations for their products. Our customers have more time to focus on branding and marketing. But we can also help them with that. As a digital-driven CDMO, we’ll apply customized brand building and digital strategies to help clients build lasting success in the marketplace. We don’t just make products, we create brands. Talking about brands: With our white label products and private label solutions companies can easily expand their existing product portfolio and aspiring entrepreneurs can get their new supplement brands off the ground fast and without big investments. We write quality with a capital letter High quality is the backbone of our operations. We invest in rigorous quality management in all our facilities in all product phases and only work with certified and authorized suppliers to ensure that our customers get the best and safest products possible. Our production facilities are reguarly audited by third parties and GMP, IFS, organic, HACCP, ISO and FSSC 22000 certified, as required. Innovating and optimizing for the future High quality standards, innovative technologies and a clear focus on the future ensure the continued success and growth of the whole 1Q Health Group. We continually invest in new product development, production process optimization and technologies to support our clients build strong brands in the international marketplace. 1Q Health – Your non-stockout address for contract manufacturing in Europe, for the global market. Learn more about 1Q Health and our product portfolio.

Company Description: Lípidos Santiga (LIPSA) is a leading company in the refining of vegetable oils and fats for the human food, animal feed, technical applications and biofuels sectors.Since our beginnings in 1973, our objective has been to become the supplier of reference for all our customers around the world, continuously providing them with high added value solutions. With a portfolio of more than 20 feedstocks and the ability to add additives and create blends, we have the widest product portfolio in the industry. And for all customers who want to go one step further in their commitment to sustainability, we also offer our range of sustainable and eco-certified products. Our experienced team works together with the best suppliers to ensure a safe and sustainable supply chain for our raw materials in social, environmental and economic terms. We also use the best and latest technology in oil refining processes, and we are at the forefront in mitigating contaminants that may be present in vegetable oils or appear during refining processes (GE, 3-MCPD esters and MOSH/MOAH) to ensure the quality of all our products. We continuously innovate our products, relying on technology to adapt to the needs of the market and together with our customers we develop tailor-made solutions to meet all their demands for vegetable oils and fats.

Company Description: GOED is the only organization focused specifically on increasing consumption of EPA and DHA omega-3s around the world. Our 200+ members represent the entire supply chain from fisheries and crude oil suppliers to refiners, concentrators and brands. GOED's extensive network helps members expand and grow their businesses. Our activities focus on maintaining quality standards, educating consumers and healthcare professionals, furthering the science, and advocating for members with governments and NGO’s throughout the world. We also offer comprehensive data on the global omega-3 supply chain, consumer market research in 20+ countries and scientific, regulatory and technical expertise.

Company Description: Since our founding in 1992, we have been committed to delivering delicious, enjoyable, and healthy food to people around the world. Our company also handles plant-based and health-promoting ingredients developed in Japan, aiming to contribute to overall wellness. At this exhibition, we will be showcasing three key products: QOL Natto Bacteria, which has been reported to reduce morning drowsiness, is one of our featured products. Ginger Extract NE, standardized for shogaol content Masking Taste, which can be used in supplements and functional foods Exhibited Products 【QOL Bacillus Natto】 Reported to improve sleep quality by reducing drowsiness upon waking. Internal monitor studies have confirmed that intake of QOL Natto Bacteria increases skin collagen density. It suggests that it may enhance vitality, improve negative mood states, and help alleviate psychological stress. 【Ginger Extract NE】 Ginger-derived polyphenols help maintain surface temperature in peripheral skin areas. Ginger Extract NE contains a high concentration of both ginger polyphenols and ginger extract. Ginger extract has been shown to promote bowel movements in individuals with constipation tendencies. Its effect of suppressing visceral fat accumulation has been confirmed. Its effect of reducing fatigue has been confirmed. 【Masking Taste】 Masks unpleasant or distinctive odors found in plant-based foods and protein drinks. Easy-to-use powder form that is effective even at low dosages (0.05–0.15%).

Company Description: SVEBA was founded in 1994 by the Salamone family as a laboratory for phytotherapeutic preparations. Over time, it has evolved into a leading design, development, and production company. Today, we are one of the main European Contractors and CDMOs operating in the Food Supplements sector. As a market leader, we take a unique, multidisciplinary approach, ensuring meticulous attention to every product detail while maintaining a strong commitment to social and environmental responsibility. We manage all phases of the product life cycle and employ the most innovative pharmaceutical technologies to meet the most ambitious needs of our clients. With over 6,000 sqm of production facilities across Italy, our daily production capacity includes: - Capsules – 1,500,000 per day - Tablets – 4,500,000 per day - Liquid sachets – 700,000 per day - Solid sachets – 1,000,000 per day - Stand-up gel – 200,000 per day - Liquid in bottles (10 to 1000 ml, depending on size) Additionally, we have dedicated R&D and Regulatory laboratories to support our clients at every stage, from formulation to the final product. SVEBA is certified GMP, ISO 9001, and ISO 13485 "Medical Devices" and is authorized to produce Organic Supplements as well as Pet and Feed Supplements. We are committed to building strong partnerships with our customers and suppliers. Our slogan: “WE MAKE IT, YOU SELL IT”. For further information, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Company Description: As a leading supplier and producer, we at Henry Lamotte Oils gain high-quality oils, vegetable butter, waxes, seed flours and oleoresins from nature's plenty. Our customers work worldwide in the industry sectors foods, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, animal nutrition and care as well as chemistry and technology. Selected suppliers worldwide, ongoing close contact with the raw material markets, our own production and storage capacities, comprehensive and customer-focused service, first-class proprietary quality control and product development combined with a wide range of quality accreditations guarantee our competitiveness. Many of our products are invisible stars of the food sector. As true all-rounders, they provide special and exotic flavours, are natural elements of a varied diet or act as nutrient suppliers, flavour carriers and colouring agents. They perform their tasks in the production of convenience products, sauces, bakery products, confectionery, delicatessen, cereals, spreads, snacks, beverages as well as seasoning and colouring ingredients. As a partner to both the processing industry and retail, we use our know-how, flexibility and passion for our products to ensure that you get the quality you need. Along the value chain, we master quality requirements and create individual solutions that meet the demands of an increasingly demanding market. Our sister company Henry Lamotte Food GmbH supplies high-quality products for food production and food trade. Henry Lamotte Services GmbH provides commercial support to both companies.

Company Description: As a high-tech biotechnology company, HSF Biotech is high-quality ingredient solutions manufacturer for human better life. Based on R&D and innovation, We serve multiple industries, such as dietary supplements, food and beverage, pharmaceutics, personal care products, animal nutrition in the global markets. As one of the global plant sterols/esters suppliers, HSF is an important pioneer in China's phytosterol/ester industry, a market promoter and a participant in the formulation of national industry standards. In 2022, HSF launched new innovations on fermentation technology, which have created a rapid and healthy growth in global reputation and technology accumulation. Company Description: As a high-tech biotechnology company based on R&D and innovation, HSF has integrated and optimized Oil Esterification and Molecular Distillation Technique, High efficiency separation technology, Functional factor microencapsulation technology, Directed microbial fermentation technology, providing systematic product solutions to the global customers in nutrition and health field.“Innovation serves a better life” is HSF’s tireless pursuit and belief of innovation and development. Our core business scope covers the research and development, production and sales of a multiple series of products including plant sterols/esters, natural vitamin E, functional oil microencapsulation, functional powder microencapsulation, microbial fermentation and ferulic acid. The products are widely used in the fields of edible oils, pharmaceutics, health foods, dairy products, dietary supplements, personal care products and animal nutrition etc.. HSF is earliest a large-scale high-tech enterprise specialized in the research and development, production and market application of phytosterols/esters in China; an important pioneer, market promoter and participant in the formulation of national industry standards of China phytosterol/esters industry; and one of the major suppliers of plant sterols/esters in the world. Our products are breaking up of foreign technology monopolies and filled the gap in the domestic market. We have successfully developed a large number of subdivided products with deep application of phytosterols/esters, high-end natural vitamin E and microencapsulated lipid powder, have been well received by well-known brand customers at home and abroad. Meanwhile, HSF has established a comprehensive technology platform and a bountiful of products and technologies with independent intellectual property rights. In 2016, HSF won the “Second Prize for Science and Technology Progress in Shaanxi Province”, in 2017, awarded the honor of “Gazelle Enterprise” in the National Agricultural Demonstration Zone. In 2018, approved as Shaanxi Province Innovation R&D Center and Provincial Innovation Demonstration Enterprise, and in 2019, approved as National Key Engineering Test and Research Center. In 2020, HSF won the second prize of Shaanxi Science and Technology Award and Shaanxi Province "Specialized and Special New" Small and Medium-sized Enterprises. In 2021, participated in two national key research and development plans, undertaken 9 national and Shaanxi provincial science and technology projects, and has 59 invention patents. The company led and participated in the drafting and formulation of national industry standards for phytosterol, phytosterol ester, natural vitamin E raw material DD oil etc.. Since 2012, with 10 years’ continuous R&D and optimization of fermentation & extracting technology, HSF invested 5,000,000 USD and 8,000,000 USD in its first and second industries zone in city of Yangling. With the two individual manufacturing sites, Fermtek™ can provide our customers options with small, mid-sized and large-scale production capacity, ranging from one –stop service. HSF is committed to taking the road of technological innovation and technology first, having a number of post-doctoral and graduate technical teams with strong independent research and development and industrialization in the fields of biology and food and core patented technologies in a number of cutting-edge biotechnology and life sciences. Meanwhile, HSF has been carrying out academic and research cooperations with China Agricultural University, JiangNan University, South China University of Technology, Jinan University, Northeast Agricultural University and other well-known universities in the field of biology and food in the country, has formed a business model driven by scientific research, development and market, with outstanding competitive advantages.

Company Description: Yesherb is a famous brand focus on natural botanical ingredients. It belongs to the manufacturer named Lifewe Bioengineering, which is an innovative high-tech enterprise integrating R&D, production and committed to providing the ingredients in the food, nutriceutical and pharmaceutical industries. We now have a team with more than 150 empolees. The marketing and sales headquarters is located in Xi'an, China, Which is named as Xi'an Lifewe Bio-tech, also wellknown as Xi’an Yuensun Bio-tech in the domestic market. And we also has a sales branch in US named Yesherb Ingredients Inc (Yesherb Group). Our factory covers an area of 35,000 square meters. We now have two main ingredients production workshops, one is food ingredients production line based on various kinds of fruit and vegetables powders. The other one is plant extract production line with featured products like Epimedium extract, Rhodiola rosea extract and other herbal extracts. For our quality control, we have equipped with advanced testing equipment such as Shimadzu from Japan and Waters from the United States. It can test the products’ content, heavy metals, pesticide residues, microorganisms and other items to ensure the products comply with different food and drug standards in various countries. Meanwhile, Our factory has obtained HACCP, FSSC22000 and other quality management system certifications, and the products have also obtained the US USDA organic and the EU organic certification, the OU Kosher certification, and the Halal certification. With years of market expansion, our ingredients brand "Yesherb" has been trusted by customers all over the world, and our products are deeply loved by our loyal customers, Our hot selling pomegranate powder, goji Powder, blueberry powder has entered the whole foods market in US. And if you have bought beet root powder from Walmart, I think you've aleady become one of our indirect customer. Also if you go shopping at ALDI food store in Europe or Australia, You will see our wheat grass powder, barely grass powder or even spirulina powder on the superfood shelf. No matter where you are, we treasure every opportunity to cooperate with you.

Company Description: Founded in 1995, Indus Biotech is a pioneer in deriving science based dietary ingredients from food chain raw materials through revolutionary patented technology. Our raw materials are sourced from verified and validated suppliers. We take ownership of the raw material from origin to production of the final product. Our proprietary products are distributed around the world by our marketing partners. Our products are backed by strong clinical and scientific evidence. We derive our ingredients from food chain raw materials. From our ingredients, we develop innovative solutions for health and wellness. OUR RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT EXCEL IN Fenugreek seeds - Fenugreek (Scientific Name: Trigonella foenum-gracum) seeds have stood the test of time as a medicinal plant. Fenugreek is an integral part of many traditional healing systems. The multiple medicinal benefits of Fenugreek seeds have led to a focus on it as a nutritional supplement. We, at Indus Biotech, have pioneered research on Fenugreek seeds. Our R&D has led to the discovery of many bioactive molecules in Fenugreek seeds. Our science has harnessed the potential of these molecules for promising healthcare applications. Cinnamon bark - Cinnamon (Scientific Name: Cinnamomum zeylanicum) bark is a traditional treatment for inflammation, pain, fever and arthritis. Cinnamon bark also boosts immunity. Our research on Cinnamon bark has led to the identification of specific polyphenols effective against chronic immune and infectious conditions including allergic rhinitis. Gotu Kola leaves - Gotu Kola (Scientific Name: Centella asiatica) leaves are part of Asian and African healing systems. The medicinal properties of Gotu Kola are derived from constituents called Triterpenes. With our platform technology we have identified and characterized our patented composition of Triterpene molecules.

Company Description: Kendy Pharma is a leading company with long tradition in the development, production and marketing of food supplements. Established in 1992, the company has state-of–the-art technical equipment for production. Kendy Pharma invests in the entire cycle of product creation—from comprehensive scientific research, through practical development, to implementation- under constant and strict quality control. The optimal effectiveness of the company’s products is achieved through careful selection and balancing of quality active ingredients. Kendy Pharma works with globally renowned suppliers such as: DSM- leading Swiss manufacturer of vitamin premixes, Naturex- expert in natural extracts, Beneo- producer of natural fibers. Kendy Pharma has been granted renowned international certificates of quality: U.S. FDA (United States Food and Drug Administration) ISO 9001:2015 GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) Audited and approved by UNICEF and GAIN (Global Alliance for Improved Nutrition- Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation)- for manufacturing of food supplements (vitamin and mineral premix) for malnourished children Since 2013, the company has held authorisation for production of human medicinal products (No. P-I-38-004) Kendy Pharma carries a wide portfolio of own brands, leaders in local and international markets, such as SupraVit - vitamins and minerals, Lactoflor Probiotics, Stabiflex and Osteoactive - bone health and joint support products. The company offers variety of products in solid dosage forms - tablets, effervescent tablets, capsules and sachets.

Company Description: CellMark is a privately-owned, independent marketing and supply chain services company providing products, services and solutions to customers and suppliers all over the world. We facilitate trade and business development across multiple industries using our many local offices and professional expertise. Through a network of 70-plus offices in 30-plus countries, we provide a full suite of services: sourcing, sales and marketing, exclusive representation, finance, logistics, regulatory compliance, business development and custom chemicals manufacturing. We also partner with clients to identify new business opportunities that add value to their processes and products, or sometimes serve purely as an external sales or sourcing division for our client. Our annual sales are approximately USD 3.6 billion, with volume of more than 7 million tons annually. Our footprint is in more than 125 markets. Serving a multitude of industries, our daily challenges come in all shapes and sizes. That means we must truly be where our customers and suppliers are, as well as being one step ahead. And our people need to be as diverse as our wide variety of business partners. One key factor for how we do business is our company culture. Centered around informed creativity, our culture is designed to empower each individual to be their own entrepreneur. We do this by shortening decision-making processes, reducing lead times, and making our clients quicker on their feet. But being swift only helps us today. In order to succeed tomorrow, we need a much larger perspective. That is why our main investments go toward continuity, longevity, and long-term business relationships based on integrity and respect.

Events: About | Company description | QEMETICA is a Polish-owned international chemical group with a strong position in global markets. It is one of the largest producers and suppliers of key chemical raw materials in Europe. Its products are used across multiple industries, including construction, agriculture, automotive, manufacturing, and everyday consumer goods that reach millions of people worldwide. The Group operates production sites in Poland, Germany, the Netherlands, and the United States, and employs around 3,500 people across several countries. Its development is supported by the strategic investor Kulczyk Investments. QEMETICA comprises nine business lines, offering dozens of solutions used in everyday life. Its largest segment, Soda, supports glass production, detergents, electronics, as well as food, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics. Salt is used in food production and water treatment and softening processes. Precipitated silica is applied in tires, shoe soles, and batteries, while silicates are used in paints, coatings, and toothpaste. The Agro segment provides crop protection solutions that improve productivity and food safety. QEMETICA Glass is a leading producer of grave lanterns in Poland, Polyurethanes supplies PUR foams for furniture and mattresses, and Cargo provides rail transport services. The newest business, QEMETICA Future, focuses on innovation and rapid industrial application of new technologies. QEMETICA combines a modern business approach with a strong commitment to sustainable development. Since 2020, the company has been a participant of the United Nations Global Compact. We focus on innovation, operational excellence, and modern management, offering our employees opportunities to grow, make an impact, and shape the future of the organization. We are looking for ambitious people who set high goals, enjoy delivering results, and want to actively contribute to change. Company Description: SE Tylose is based in Wiesbaden, Germany, producing approximately 65.000 tons of cellulose ether annually and is one of the world's most important cellulose ether suppliers. Company Description: With several decades of experience, the Naturacare group is dedicated, thanks to the experience of these 3 entities, to the design, production and packaging of food supplements promoting the improvement of human and animal health. The choice of ingredients selected thanks to their scientifically proven effectiveness, the millennial tradition of certain peoples, the quality of controls at the entry and exit of the products allow us to ensure optimal quality to offer innovative finished products. More than 1,500 materials selected from plants, vitamins, minerals, trace elements, probiotic strains, enzymes and other substances allow us to consider very broad, state-of-the-art formula solutions for our customers. We offer solutions to support our customers for the marketing of natural health products promoting a preventive approach to support the health capital of different categories of the human population. The scientific collaboration developed since always with the scientific actors emanating from the university circles, the health nutrition, the medical world, in connection with our partners lab customers and upstream suppliers have made it possible to constitute an internal knowledge base at the service of marketers. By extension of our expertise, we offer original and proven solutions to support the development of nutritional supplements for pets. Mainly dogs, cats, horses. Our desire is to support the players already present on the animal nutrition market with varied formulations and galenics, experienced and tested on these animals. Backed by experience in palatability, the specificity of different breeds in conjunction with veterinarians and animal owners, the group provides a new original solution to develop this market segment. Faced with the new expectations of consumers committed to respecting and protecting the environment, the search for naturalness, the group has developed new cosmetic solutions (toothpaste, shampoos, etc.) in clean-label without preservatives in the form of which is part of the slow-cosmetic trend.

Company Description: Biofactoria Naturae was born in 2013 with a very clear mission: “To improve people’s health thanks to the elaboration of 100% natural products, of quality and within everyone’s reach”. The Aloe Vera we use comes from our own organic plantations in Andalusia, and we buy our seasonal fruits and vegetables from local suppliers. Sustainability above all! And, if something is perfect, why should we change it? That is why we can reduce the handling of our raw material to a minimum, limiting ourselves to treating it with the most advanced technology. By using Natural Cold Process or HPP systems, we are able to produce fresher and healthier foods, as avoiding pasteurization we do not take away nutrients or natural properties, neither we have to add chemical preservatives. Controlling the processes of production, elaboration and delivery of the products in store is fundamental to bring to your home that extra touch of security, quality and flavor so characteristic of our brand.

Company Description: Aromatic & Allied is a family owned business since 1977. Company Description: Established in 1982, “Agence de Promotion des Investissements Agricoles” (APIA) is a Tunisian public institution run by the Ministry of Agriculture that was created to promote private investment in the fields of agriculture, fisheries and related services. Based on its dedicated expertise, APIA supports its members in successfully implementing their respective projects. In this context, APIA offers diverse services such as obtaining financial and tax benefits, assisting promoters in the compilation of investment and managerial records, matching Tunisian operators with potential foreign counterparts and the participation in trade fairs and exhibitions in Tunisia and abroad. APIA’s vision is to improve the competitive advantages of the sector and to strengthen the industry’s positive image in the orld market. APIA would very much welcome the opportunity to introduce importers to profitable new trade opportunities with Tunisian suppliers at the Tunisian Country Pavilion.
